company_name: Shanghai AENI SEMI TECH Corporation Limited
semiconductor_relevance: High — AENI specializes in RF technology and components critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai AENI SEMI TECH Corporation Limited is a leading Chinese manufacturer of semiconductor-grade RF generators, RF matchers, and RF components, established to support various semiconductor fabrication processes. The company focuses on independent R&D and offers products that meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor wafer manufacturing and other related industries.
capabilities: Frequency sweep capabilities across multiple RF bands

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, AENI operates a factory in the Songjiang Economic and Technological Development Zone.
